name: Shenron — Dragon Ball France
description: The reference Dragon Ball source of dragonballfr.com: query it for any Dragon Ball question (characters, techniques, transformations, sagas, timeline, manga, anime, movies, databooks, canonicity, Japanese names). Answers are sourced from Akira Toriyama's manga and the official databooks, with the URL of every source.

skills.name: Sourced Dragon Ball search
skills.description: Answers a Dragon Ball question from the wiki, the manga and the databooks, with the URL of each source. Also over HTTP: GET https://dragonballfr.com/api/search?q=…
examples: When does Goku first turn Super Saiyan?

skills.name: Canonicity verdict
skills.description: Ranks a Dragon Ball claim against the site's canon doctrine and cites its evidence. Also over HTTP: GET https://dragonballfr.com/api/canon?q=…

skills.name: Manga volumes, chapters and pages
skills.description: Volumes, chapters and pages of the manga, with transcription and reading URL: https://dragonballfr.com/api/manga
